                            + (f" {p['record']}" if p['record'] else "") for p in past))
        self._say(f"  failure bank: {len(bank)} failing output(s)"
                  + (" (" + ", ".join(f"{m}: {n}" for m, n in sorted(by_model.items())) + ")"
                     if bank else ""))
        for line in briefing:
            self._say(f"  briefing: {line}")
        if not direct:
            raise Stop(2, f"No call site of decision #{self.decision_id} uses {d['label']!r} any "
                          "more; nothing to change.")

    def step_fit_check(self, error) -> None:
        data, why = reusable_check(self.project, self.decision)
        if data is None:
            if not self.opts.apply:
                raise Stop(2, f"\nDry run: the fit check can't be reused ({why}). Run with --apply "
                              "to run it (it shows the cost and asks first). Nothing changed.")
            from notbydefault.fit.run import CheckOptions, check_model_decision
            self._say(f"\nFit check: {why}; running it"
                      + (f" again (last error: {error})" if error else ""))
            code = check_model_decision(self.project, self.decision_id,
                                        CheckOptions(max_cost=self.opts.max_cost,
                                                     yes=self.opts.yes),
                                        client=self.client, tracer=self.tracer, ask=self.ask,
                                        out=self.out)
            if code == 1:
                raise Stop(1, "Fit check not run; nothing changed.")
            if code != 0:
                raise RuntimeError(f"fit check exited {code}")
            with Graph.for_project(self.project) as g:
                self.decision = g.get_node(self.decision_id)
            data, why = reusable_check(self.project, self.decision)
            if data is None:
                raise RuntimeError(f"fit check ran but its results can't be used: {why}")
            self.tracer.event("fit_check_run", "verification", why)
        else:
            self.tracer.event("fit_check_reused", "verification", why,
                              results=self.decision["data"].get("results"),
                              trace_id=data.get("trace_id"))
            self._say(f"\nFit check: reusing {self.decision['data'].get('results')} ({why})")
        self.results = data

    def step_recommend(self, error) -> None:
        from notbydefault.fit.providers import load_catalog, split_id
        v = self.results["verdict"]
        cfg = self.results["config"]
        stats = self.results["stats"]
        current = stats.get(cfg["chosen"]) or {}
        model, setup = v["recommended"]
        self._say(f"  verdict: {v['kind']}: {v['summary']}")
        if v["kind"] == "keep":
            raise Stop(0, f"Recommendation: keep {cfg['chosen']}; nothing to change.")
        if v["kind"] != "switch":
            raise Stop(2, "Recommendation: none (the fit check had too little evidence); rerun "
                          f"`notbydefault check {self.decision_id}` with more cases. Nothing changed.")
        if setup != "alone":
            raise Stop(2, f"Recommendation: {model} with a verifier and retries; adding a verifier "
                          "loop to the code is not automated yet. Nothing changed.")
        rec = stats[model]
        catalog = getattr(self.client, "catalog", None) or load_catalog(self.project)
        providers = catalog.get("providers") or {}
        old, new = split_id(cfg["chosen"]), split_id(model)
        self.target, self.old_target = model, cfg["chosen"]
        self.branch = branch_name(self.decision_id, model)
        edits, by_file = [], {}
        for s in self.inv["sites"]:
            by_file.setdefault(s.path, []).append(s)
        for path, sites in by_file.items():
            if not path.endswith(".py"):
                raise EditError(f"{path}: only Python call sites can be edited automatically")
            before = read_raw(self.project / path)
            after, notes = edit_file(before, path, sites, old, new, providers)
            edits.append(FileEdit(path, before, after, [s.describe() for s in sites], notes))
        self.edits = edits
        self.providers = providers
        self._say(f"\nRecommend: switch {cfg['chosen']} -> {model}")
        self._say(f"  correct {correct_text(rec)}, hard {hard_text(rec)}, "
                  f"verifier pass {rec['pass_rate']:.0%}, "
                  f"${rec['monthly_cost']:.2f}/month vs ${current.get('monthly_cost', 0):.2f}, "
                  f"latency {rec['avg_latency_s']:.1f}s vs {current.get('avg_latency_s', 0):.1f}s "
                  "per call")
        for s, o in self.inv["excluded"]:
            warn = (f"; its own fit check REJECTED {model}" if model in o["rejects"] else "")
            self._say(f"  not changing {s.describe()}: it is decision #{o['id']}'s call site{warn}")
        if old[0] != new[0]:
            self._say(f"  provider changes {old[0]} -> {new[0]}: deployments need "
                      f"{providers[new[0]]['key_env']} set")
        self._say("")
        for e in edits:
            self._say(e.diff().rstrip("\n"))
            for n in e.notes:
                self._say(f"  ({n})")
        self.tracer.event("recommendation", "planning", f"switch {cfg['chosen']} -> {model}",
                          files=[e.path for e in edits], branch=self.branch)
        if not self.opts.apply:
            raise Stop(0, f"\nDry run: nothing changed. Re-run with --apply to make these edits on "
                          f"branch {self.branch}.")
        if not self.opts.yes and not self._ask_yes(
                f"\nApply on a new branch {self.branch}? [y/N] "):
            raise Stop(1, "Not approved; nothing changed.")

    def step_branch(self, error) -> None:
        root = Path(git(self.project, "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"))
        self.start_branch = current_branch(self.project)
        if self.start_branch != self.branch:
            dirty = git(self.project, "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=no")
            if dirty:
                raise Stop(1, f"Uncommitted changes in {root}:\n{dirty}\nCommit or stash them first "
                              "(resolve must be able to restore a clean branch). Nothing changed.")
            exists = bool(git(self.project, "branch", "--list", self.branch))
            if exists:
                if git(self.project, "rev-parse", self.branch) != git(self.project, "rev-parse",
                                                                      "HEAD"):
                    raise Stop(1, f"Branch {self.branch} exists and differs from HEAD; delete or "
                                  "rename it first. Nothing changed.")
                git(self.project, "switch", self.branch)
            else:
                git(self.project, "switch", "-c", self.branch)
                self.created_branch = True
        if current_branch(self.project) in PROTECTED_BRANCHES:
                    lines.append(f"  WARNING: still modified after restoring:\n{dirty}")
                elif self.start_branch != self.branch:
                    git(self.project, "switch", self.start_branch)
                    lines.append(f"  branch {self.branch} is clean (no commits, no changes); "
                                 f"switched back to {self.start_branch}")
        except (GitError, OSError) as e:
            lines.append(f"  could not finish restoring: {e}; check `git status`")
        if f.step in ("investigate", "fit_check", "recommend"):
            lines.append("  nothing was changed")
        return "\n".join(lines)


def reusable_check(project: Path, decision: dict) -> tuple[dict | None, str]:
    """(results, why) of the decision's last fit check if it still describes the code, else
    (None, why not)."""
    from notbydefault.fit import callsite as callsite_mod
    from notbydefault.fit import verifiers as verifiers_mod
    data = decision["data"]
    if data.get("status") == "stale":
        return None, f"decision is stale: {data.get('stale_reason')}"
    if not data.get("verdict") or not data.get("results"):
        return None, "no fit check yet"
    path = Path(project) / data["results"]
    if not path.is_file():
        return None, f"results file {data['results']} is missing"
    res = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    try:
        site = callsite_mod.locate(Path(project), decision)
    except LookupError as e:
        return None, str(e)
    if site.snippet_sha != res["callsite"].get("snippet_sha"):
        return None, f"{site.file} changed since the fit check"
    vpath = verifiers_mod.verifier_path(Path(project), decision["id"])
    if vpath.exists() and verifiers_mod.load(vpath).sha != res["verifiers"].get("sha"):
        return None, f"{vpath.name} changed since the fit check"
    return res, (f"run {res['run_at'][:10]}, trace {res.get('trace_id') or '-'}; call site and "
                 "verifiers unchanged since")


def test_command(project: Path) -> list[str] | None:
    """The project's own test command: pytest when it has Python tests, else `npm test`."""
    project = Path(project)
    for p in project.rglob("*.py"):
        rel = p.relative_to(project).parts
        if TEST_SKIP_DIRS & set(rel[:-1]):
            continue
        if rel[0] == "tests" or re.match(r"(test_.*|.*_test)\.py$", p.name):
            return [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q"]
    pkg = project / "package.json"
    if pkg.is_file():
        try:
            if (json.loads(pkg.read_text(encoding="utf-8")).get("scripts") or {}).get("test"):
                return ["npm", "test", "--silent"]
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            pass
    return None


def _links(r: Resolver) -> list[str]:
    """Entire checkpoint links of the commits that added/changed the decision record."""
    from notbydefault.checkpoints import checkpoint_of
    from notbydefault.entire import Entire, commit_link, repo_slug
    rel = r._rel(r.record_path)
    try:
        log = git(r.project, "log", "--format=%H%x09%s", "--", rel)
    except GitError:
        return []
    slug = repo_slug(r.project)
    out = []
    for line in log.splitlines()[:5]:
        sha, subject = line.split("\t", 1)
        cid = checkpoint_of(r.project, sha, r.entire or Entire())
        link = commit_link(slug, sha) if slug else f"(no GitHub origin) commit {sha}"
        out.append(f"| {subject[:70]} | {cid or '-'} | {link} |")
    return out


def correct_text(s: dict) -> str:
    """"10/12" against reference answers; "-" when the fit check had none."""
    return f"{round(s['correct_rate'] * s['n_ref'])}/{s['n_ref']}" if s and s.get("n_ref") else "-"


def hard_text(s: dict) -> str:
    return f"{s['hard_correct']}/{s['hard_total']}" if s and s.get("hard_total") else "-"


def pr_description(r: Resolver) -> str:
    res, v = r.results, r.results["verdict"]
    stats = res["stats"]
    cur, new = stats.get(r.old_target) or {}, stats[r.target]
    vf = r.verification
    old_p, new_p = r.old_target.split(":", 1)[0], r.target.split(":", 1)[0]
    pcfg = r.providers

    def both(label, key, fmt, source):
        old = format(cur[key], fmt) if key in cur else "-"
        return f"| {label} | {old} | {format(new[key], fmt)} | {source} |"

    correct, hard = correct_text, hard_text

    def residency(p):
        return ", ".join(pcfg.get(p, {}).get("data_residency") or []) or "none guaranteed"
    budget = res["assumptions"].get("budget")
    lines = [f"# Resolve #{r.decision_id}: switch {r.old_target} -> {r.target}", "",
             f"Decision #{r.decision_id} (`{r.decision['label']}`), task: "
             f"{res['callsite'].get('task') or '-'}", "", "## Why", "", v["summary"], "",
             "## Changes", ""]
    for e in r.edits:
        lines.append(f"- `{e.path}`: {', '.join(e.sites)}" + "".join(f"; {n}" for n in e.notes))
    for s, o in r.inv["excluded"]:
        lines.append(f"- not changed: `{s.describe()}`, decision #{o['id']}'s call site"
                     + (f" (its fit check rejected `{r.target}`)" if r.target in o["rejects"]
                        else ""))
    for s in r.inv["callers"]:
        lines.append(f"- not changed: caller `{s.describe()}` ({s.via})")
    if old_p != new_p:
        lines.append(f"- provider {old_p} -> {new_p}: set `{pcfg[new_p]['key_env']}` in every "
                     f"deployment (`{pcfg[old_p]['key_env']}` is no longer read here)")
    lines += ["", "## Evidence", "", "| | current | new | source |", "|---|---|---|---|",
              f"| model | `{r.old_target}` | `{r.target}` | fit check verdict: {v['kind']} |",
              f"| correct vs reference | {correct(cur)} | {correct(new)} | "
              f"`{r.decision['data'].get('results')}` |",
              f"| hard cases | {hard(cur)} | {hard(new)} | fit check |",
              both("verifier pass (fit check)", "pass_rate", ".0%", f"`{vf['path']}`"),
              both("cost per call ($)", "avg_cost", ".6f", res["pricing"]["source"]),
              both("monthly at assumed volume ($)", "monthly_cost", ".2f",
                   f"budget ${budget:.2f}" if budget else "no budget recorded"),
              both("latency per call (s)", "avg_latency_s", ".1f", "fit check"),
              f"| data residency | {residency(old_p)} | {residency(new_p)} | provider catalog |",
              f"| verifiers on the new code | | {vf['production_pass']}/{vf['cases']} production, "
              f"{vf['correct']}/{vf['cases']} vs reference ({vf['banked']} failure-bank cases "
              f"first) | {vf['mode']} |",
              f"| project tests | | {r.tests['status']} | {r.tests['command'] or r.tests['summary']} |",
              "", "## Traces", "",
              f"- resolve: `{r.tracer.trace_id or 'not exported (telemetry off)'}`",
              f"- fit check: `{res.get('trace_id') or '-'}`", "",
              "## Checkpoints", "", "| commit | checkpoint | link |", "|---|---|---|"]
    links = _links(r)
    lines += links or ["| decision record not committed yet | - | - |"]
    lines += ["", "## Decision record", "", f"`{r._rel(r.record_path)}`", "",
              "## Steps", "", "| step | focus_area | attempts | status |", "|---|---|---|---|"]
    lines += [f"| {s['step']} | {s['focus_area']} | {s['attempts']} | {s['status']} |"
              for s in r.state["steps"]] + [f"| record | state | - | this file |", ""]
    return "\n".join(lines)


def resolve(project: Path, decision_id: int, opts: ResolveOptions, **kw) -> int:
    return Resolver(project, decision_id, opts, **kw).run()

@dataclass

    decision_id: int
    run_at: str
    requests_made: int | None
    cache_hits: int | None
    spent: float            # list price of the requests made

def load_checks(project: Path) -> list[Check]:
    out = []
    for p in sorted((project / ".notbydefault" / "results").glob("*.json")):
        try:
            d = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
            continue
        if "decision_id" not in d or "rows" not in d:
            continue
        req = d.get("requests") or {}
        out.append(Check(
            path=p.relative_to(project).as_posix(), decision_id=int(d["decision_id"]),
            run_at=str(d.get("run_at", "")), requests_made=req.get("made"),
            cache_hits=req.get("cache_hits"), spent=float(d.get("spent") or 0),
            comparison_cost=sum(float(r.get("cost") or 0) for r in d["rows"])
            + sum(float(j.get("cost") or 0) for j in d.get("judge") or []),
            free_tier=bool((d.get("pricing") or {}).get("free_tier")),
            stopped=bool(d.get("stopped")), data=d))
    return sorted(out, key=lambda c: c.run_at)

    for c in checks:
        L.append(f"| `{c.path}` | #{c.decision_id} | {c.run_at[:16].replace('T', ' ')} | "
                 f"{_num(c.requests_made)} | {_num(c.cache_hits)} | {_money(c.spent, 4)} | "

    if not checks:
        L.append("| no fit checks yet | | | | | | | |")

def export(project: Path, out_dir: Path, checks_per_month: float = DEFAULT_CHECKS_PER_MONTH,
           projects_per_customer: float = DEFAULT_PROJECTS_PER_CUSTOMER, out=print) -> int:
    project = Path(project).resolve()
    if not db_path(project).exists():
        out(f"No Decision Graph at {db_path(project)}.")
        return 1
    if checks_per_month < 0 or projects_per_customer < 0:
        out("--checks-per-month and --projects-per-customer must not be negative.")
        return 1
    checks = load_checks(project)
    with Graph.for_project(project) as g:
        rows = decision_rows(project, g, checks)
    ue = unit_economics(checks, checks_per_month, projects_per_customer)
    out_dir = Path(out_dir)
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (out_dir / "costs.csv").write_text(render_csv(rows), encoding="utf-8", newline="")
    (out_dir / "costs.md").write_text(render_md(project.name, rows, checks, ue),
                                      encoding="utf-8", newline="")
    out(f"Wrote {out_dir / 'costs.csv'} and {out_dir / 'costs.md'}: {len(rows)} decision(s), "
        f"{len(checks)} fit check(s); our LLM cost per customer "
        f"${ue['cost_per_customer_month']:.4f}/month at {checks_per_month:g} check(s)/month "
        "(assumption).")
    return 0

def decision_rows(project: Path, graph: Graph, checks: list[Check]) -> list[dict]:
    rows = []
    for d in graph.nodes("decision"):
        data = d["data"]
        mine = [c for c in checks if c.decision_id == d["id"]]
        linked = next((c for c in mine if c.path == data.get("results")), None)
        latest = linked or (mine[-1] if mine else None)
        row = dict.fromkeys(CSV_COLUMNS, "")
        row.update(decision_id=d["id"], label=d["label"], kind=data.get("kind", ""),
                   category=data.get("category", ""), status=data.get("status", ""),
                   checks_run=len(mine))
        if latest is not None:
            res = latest.data
            verdict = res.get("verdict") or {}
            cur = _stat(res.get("stats") or {}, verdict.get("reference"))
            rec = _stat(res.get("stats") or {}, verdict.get("recommended"))
            a = res.get("assumptions") or {}
            row.update(verdict=verdict.get("kind", ""),
                       current_setup=cur["name"] if cur else "",
                       recommended_setup=rec["name"] if rec else "",
                       assumed_users=a.get("users"), assumed_calls_per_user=a.get("calls_per_user"),
                       budget_monthly_usd=a.get("budget"), latest_check_at=latest.run_at,
                       fit_check_list_cost_usd=round(latest.comparison_cost, 6),
                       our_requests_made=latest.requests_made, our_cache_hits=latest.cache_hits,
                       our_list_cost_usd=round(latest.spent, 6), free_tier=latest.free_tier,
                       results_file=latest.path)
            cm = (cur or {}).get("monthly_cost")
            rm = (rec or {}).get("monthly_cost")
            if cm is not None:
                row["current_monthly_usd"] = round(cm, 2)
            if rm is not None:
                row["recommended_monthly_usd"] = round(rm, 2)
            if cm is not None and rm is not None:
                row["savings_monthly_usd"] = round(cm - rm, 2)
        rows.append({k: ("" if v is None else v) for k, v in row.items()})
    return rows


def unit_economics(checks: list[Check], checks_per_month: float,
                   projects_per_customer: float) -> dict:
    n = len(checks)
    avg = (lambda xs: sum(xs) / len(xs) if xs else 0.0)
    per_check = avg([c.spent for c in checks])
    per_check_full = avg([c.comparison_cost for c in checks])
    made = [c.requests_made for c in checks if c.requests_made is not None]
    per_project = checks_per_month * per_check
    return {"checks": n, "checks_per_month": checks_per_month,
            "projects_per_customer": projects_per_customer,
            "cost_per_check": per_check, "comparison_cost_per_check": per_check_full,
            "requests_per_check": avg(made) if made else None,
            "cost_per_project_month": per_project,
            "cost_per_customer_month": per_project * projects_per_customer,
            "comparison_cost_per_customer_month":
                checks_per_month * per_check_full * projects_per_customer,
            "free_tier_checks": sum(c.free_tier for c in checks)}

"""`notbydefault eval`: measure NotByDefault itself on cases with known right answers.

Sections (cases in eval/cases/, one neatlogs trace each):
  detection     PreToolUse hook on tool calls that are / are not stack decisions
  pivot         UserPromptSubmit Pivot Check on real pivots vs ordinary prompts
  requirements  `require` on new requirements, expected stale / needs review / valid per decision
  fit           model-fit verdicts read from a project's saved results (never run here)

Every case runs on a throwaway project in a temp dir. LLM calls go through the project's
Groq roles; a Gemini call is refused, so nothing here spends Gemini quota. Model replies are
cached in eval/.cache so a rerun with unchanged prompts is free and repeatable.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import contextlib
import glob
import json
import os
import shutil
import sqlite3
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from notbydefault import REPO_ROOT
from notbydefault.graph import Graph

EVAL_DIR = REPO_ROOT / "eval"
CASES = EVAL_DIR / "cases"
CACHE = EVAL_DIR / ".cache"
SECTIONS = ("detection", "pivot", "requirements", "fit")


# --- helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

METRIC_FNS = {"detection": detection_metrics, "pivot": pivot_metrics,
              "requirements": requirements_metrics, "fit": fit_metrics}


def score(section: dict, name: str) -> None:
    """metrics on the original cases (comparable across versions) and on the held-out ones."""
    rows = section["cases"]
    orig = [r for r in rows if r.get("split", "original") == "original"]
    section["metrics"] = METRIC_FNS[name](orig) if orig else None
    held = [r for r in rows if r.get("split") == "heldout"]
    section["heldout_metrics"] = METRIC_FNS[name](held) if held else None


# --- report ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

METRICS = {
    "detection": ["cases", "passed", "precision", "recall", "interruptions",
                  "false_interruptions", "false_interruption_rate"],
    "pivot": ["cases", "passed", "precision", "recall", "false_pivots", "missed_pivots",
              "llm_calls_per_ordinary_prompt", "ordinary_prompts_reaching_llm",
              "mapping_accuracy", "llm_calls"],
    "requirements": ["cases", "passed", "accuracy", "decisions_right", "false_stale",
                     "missed_stale", "llm_calls"],
    "fit": ["cases", "passed", "final", "pending"],
}


def _fmt(v) -> str:
    return "-" if v is None else str(v)


def _grid(rows: list[tuple]) -> list[str]:
    w = [max(len(r[i]) for r in rows) for i in range(len(rows[0]) - 1)]
    lines = ["  ".join(f"{c:<{w[i]}}" for i, c in enumerate(r[:-1])) + "  " + r[-1] for r in rows]
    lines.insert(1, "-" * min(130, max(len(l) for l in lines)))
    return lines


def table(results: dict) -> list[str]:
    s = results["sections"]
    rows = [("section", "metric", "original", "held-out")]
    for sec, keys in METRICS.items():
        if sec not in s:
            continue
        m, h = s[sec].get("metrics") or {}, s[sec].get("heldout_metrics") or {}
        for k in keys:
            rows.append((sec, k.replace("_", " "), _fmt(m.get(k)), _fmt(h.get(k))))
        if sec == "fit":
            for r in s["fit"]["cases"]:
                val = (f"{r['verdict']}: {r['summary']}" if r["status"] == "final"
                       else f"PENDING (provisional: {r.get('provisional_verdict') or '-'})")
                rows.append(("fit", f"decision #{r['decision_id']} ({r.get('split', 'original')})",
                             val[:100], ""))
        rows.append((sec, "trace id", s[sec].get("trace_id") or "-", ""))
    return _grid(rows)


def failure_lines(results: dict) -> list[str]:
    fails = [(name, f) for name in SECTIONS if name in results["sections"]
             for f in results["sections"][name]["failures"]]
    lines = [f"Failures ({len(fails)}):"]
    for name, f in fails:
        where = f["case"] + (f" / {f['decision']}" if f.get("decision") else "")
        tag = " (held-out)" if f.get("split") == "heldout" else ""
        lines.append(f"  [{name}]{tag} {where}: {f['reason']}")
    return lines


def _results(version: str) -> dict | None:
    path = EVAL_DIR / "results" / f"{version}.json"
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if path.exists() else None


def compare(versions: list[str], out=print) -> int:
    """Every metric and trace id side by side: each version on the original cases, then each
    version on the held-out cases (from <version>-heldout.json, or the version's own run)."""
    files = {v: _results(v) for v in versions}
    missing = [v for v, r in files.items() if r is None]
    if missing:
        out(f"No results for {', '.join(missing)} in eval/results/")
        return 1
    cols = [(v, files[v], "metrics") for v in versions]
    for v in versions:
        held = _results(f"{v}-heldout") or files[v]
        if any((sec.get("heldout_metrics") for sec in held["sections"].values())):
            cols.append((f"{v} held-out", held, "heldout_metrics"))
    rows = [("section", "metric", *[c[0] for c in cols])]
    for sec, keys in METRICS.items():
        for k in keys:
            rows.append((sec, k.replace("_", " "),
                         *[_fmt(((r["sections"].get(sec) or {}).get(key) or {}).get(k))
                           for _, r, key in cols]))
        rows.append((sec, "trace id", *[(r["sections"].get(sec) or {}).get("trace_id") or "-"
                                        for _, r, _k in cols]))
    out("\n".join(_grid(rows)))
    last = versions[-1]
    out("")
    out("\n".join(failure_lines(files[last])).replace("Failures", f"Remaining failures in {last}", 1))
    return 0


def git_commit() -> str:
    try:
        return subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "--short", "HEAD"], cwd=REPO_ROOT,
                              capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10).stdout.strip()
    except Exception:
        return ""


def _printer(line: str = "") -> None:
    print(line, flush=True)


def run(version: str = "v1", sections: list[str] | None = None, out_path: Path | None = None,
        out=_printer, which: str = "all") -> int:
    global _version
    from notbydefault.awake import keep_awake
    from notbydefault.fit.tracing import make_tracer
    _version = version
    sections = sections or [s for s in SECTIONS if load_cases(s, which)]
    out_path = out_path or EVAL_DIR / "results" / f"{version}.json"
    results = {"version": version, "cases": which, "sections": {}}
    if out_path.exists() and set(sections) != set(SECTIONS) and which == "all":   # update some sections in place
        results = json.loads(out_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    results.update(run_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
                   commit=git_commit())
    tracer = make_tracer("notbydefault-eval-" + version, spill_dir=EVAL_DIR / ".telemetry")

    def save():
        results["telemetry"] = {"exporter": "neatlogs" if tracer.enabled else "off",
                                "export": getattr(tracer, "export_status", "off"),
                                "journal": getattr(tracer, "journal_path", None)}
        out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        out_path.write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2, default=str) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

    with keep_awake():
        for name in sections:
            out(f"running {name} ...")
            started = time.perf_counter()
            with tracer.root(f"notbydefault.eval.{name}", {"notbydefault.eval_version": version,
                                                           "notbydefault.eval_section": name}):
                trace_id = tracer.trace_id
                section = RUNNERS[name](tracer, out, which)
                score(section, name)
                if section["metrics"]:
                    tracer.annotate({f"notbydefault.eval.{k}": v
                                     for k, v in section["metrics"].items()})
                if section["heldout_metrics"]:
                    tracer.annotate({f"notbydefault.eval.heldout.{k}": v
                                     for k, v in section["heldout_metrics"].items()})
            section["trace_id"] = trace_id
            section["seconds"] = round(time.perf_counter() - started, 1)
            results["sections"][name] = section
            m, h = section["metrics"], section["heldout_metrics"]
            out(f"  {name}: "
                + (f"{m['passed']}/{m['cases']}" if m else "")
                + (f" (held-out {h['passed']}/{h['cases']})" if h else "")
                + f" in {section['seconds']}s")
            save()                                   # after every section
        tracer.flush()                               # bounded; never hangs the eval
    if not getattr(tracer, "export_ok", True):       # trace ids were never delivered
        for section in results["sections"].values():
            section["trace_exported"] = False
    save()

    out("")
    out("\n".join(table(results)))
    out("")
    out("\n".join(failure_lines(results)))
    t = results["telemetry"]
    if t["exporter"] == "neatlogs":
        out(f"\nneatlogs export: {t['export']}" + (f"; journal kept in {t['journal']}"
                                                   if t["journal"] else ""))
    out(f"Saved {out_path.relative_to(REPO_ROOT).as_posix() if out_path.is_relative_to(REPO_ROOT) else out_path}")
    return 0

def record(graph, prompt: str, imp: dict, session_id: str | None, result: dict) -> int:
    label = (imp["change"] or prompt)[:120]
    pid = graph.add_node("pivot", label, {
        "status": "proposed", "prompt": prompt[:2000], "change": imp["change"],
        "conflicts": imp["conflicts"], "decisions": [d["id"] for d in imp["decisions"]],
        "confirmed_by": result.get("model"),
        "proposed_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
    }, session_id)
    for d in imp["decisions"]:
        graph.add_edge(pid, d["id"], "affects")
    return pid


def pending(graph, session_id: str | None) -> dict | None:
    """The latest proposed pivot of this session, if any."""
    for p in reversed(graph.nodes("pivot")):
        if p["data"].get("status") == "proposed" and (session_id is None or p["session_id"] == session_id):
            return p
    return None


def resolve(graph, pivot: dict, status: str, prompt: str = "") -> list[int]:
    """Record the user's choice. An accepted pivot marks the decisions it affects stale."""
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")
    graph.update_data(pivot["id"], status=status, resolved_at=now, user_answer=prompt[:500])
    stale = []
    if status == "accepted":
        for did in pivot["data"].get("decisions", []):
            d = graph.get_node(did)
            if d and d["type"] == "decision":
                graph.update_data(did, status="stale", stale_since=now,
                                  stale_reason=f"pivot #{pivot['id']} accepted: {pivot['data'].get('change')}",
                                  stale_cause=pivot["id"])
                stale.append(did)
    if stale and getattr(graph, "path", None) is not None:
        from notbydefault.records import write_record   # fast: no Brain call from the hook
        for did in stale:
            write_record(graph.path.parents[1], graph, did,
                         f"stale: pivot #{pivot['id']} accepted ({pivot['data'].get('change')})")
    return stale

"""`notbydefault checkpoints <id>`: the Entire checkpoint of the commit that added a record.

  1. the decision's record path (decisions/NNNN-<slug>.md)
  2. `git log --diff-filter=A` -> the full SHA of the commit that added it
  3. its checkpoint: the commit's `Entire-Checkpoint:` trailer, else
     `entire checkpoint explain --commit <sha> --json`
  4. the matching rows of `entire checkpoint list --json`, and the link
     https://entire.io/gh/<owner>/<repo>/commit/<FULL_SHA>
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from pathlib import Path

from notbydefault.entire import Entire, commit_link, git, repo_slug


def record_commit(project: Path, record: str) -> str | None:
    """Full SHA of the commit that added `record` (oldest add wins), or None."""
    out = git(["log", "--diff-filter=A", "--format=%H", "--", record], project)
    shas = (out or "").split()
    return shas[-1] if shas else None


def checkpoint_of(project: Path, sha: str, entire: Entire) -> str | None:
    body = git(["log", "-1", "--format=%B", sha], project) or ""
    m = re.search(r"^Entire-Checkpoint:\s*(\S+)", body, re.M)
    if m:
        return m.group(1)
    info = entire.checkpoint_explain(sha, project, commit=True)
    return (info or {}).get("checkpoint_id")


def show(project: Path, decision_id: int, entire: Entire | None = None, out=print) -> int:
    from notbydefault.graph import Graph, db_path
    from notbydefault.records import existing_path
    project = Path(project).resolve()
    if not db_path(project).exists():
        out(f"No Decision Graph at {db_path(project)}.")
        return 1
    with Graph.for_project(project) as g:
        d = g.get_node(decision_id)
    if not d or d["type"] != "decision":
        out(f"No decision #{decision_id}")
        return 1
    path = existing_path(project, d)
    if path is None:
        out(f"Decision #{decision_id} has no decision record yet; run "
            f"`python -m notbydefault records {decision_id}` and commit it.")
        return 1
    rel = path.relative_to(project).as_posix()
    entire = entire or Entire()
    slug = repo_slug(project)
    sha = record_commit(project, rel)
    out(f"Decision #{decision_id} {d['label']}: record {rel}")
    if sha is None:
        out("  not committed yet: commit it, then run this again. Its checkpoint link will be "
            f"https://entire.io/gh/{slug or '<owner>/<repo>'}/commit/<FULL_SHA>")
        return 0
    out(f"  added in commit {sha}")
    cid = checkpoint_of(project, sha, entire)
    out(f"  checkpoint: {cid or 'none linked (' + (entire.last_error() or 'no Entire-Checkpoint trailer') + ')'}")
    rows = entire.checkpoint_list(project)
    if rows is None:
        out(f"  `entire checkpoint list` unavailable: {entire.last_error()}")
    else:
        mine = [r for r in rows if cid and r.get("checkpoint_id") == cid]
        out("  entire checkpoint list:" + ("" if mine else " (no matching row)"))
        for r in mine:
            out(f"    {r.get('checkpoint_id')}  {r.get('date', '')}  {r.get('agent', '')}  "
                f"\"{r.get('message', '')}\"  sessions: {', '.join(r.get('session_ids') or [r.get('session_id') or '-'])}")
    if slug:
        out(f"  link: {commit_link(slug, sha)}")
    else:
        out("  link: (origin is not a GitHub remote; format is "
            "https://entire.io/gh/<owner>/<repo>/commit/<FULL_SHA>)")
    return 0

def folder(project: Path) -> Path:
    return Path(project) / "decisions"


def slug(decision: dict) -> str:
    kind = decision["data"].get("kind") or "decision"
    prefix = "ai-model" if kind == "model" else (decision["data"].get("category") or kind)
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", f"{prefix}-{decision['label']}".lower()).strip("-")[:60]


def next_path(project: Path, decision: dict) -> Path:
    f = folder(project)
    numbers = [int(m.group(1)) for p in f.glob("*.md") if (m := re.match(r"(\d{4})-", p.name))]
    return f / f"{max(numbers, default=0) + 1:04d}-{slug(decision)}.md"


def existing_path(project: Path, decision: dict) -> Path | None:
    rel = decision["data"].get("decision_record")
    if rel and (Path(project) / rel).is_file():
        return Path(project) / rel
    for p in sorted(folder(project).glob("*.md")):   # a record written before it was linked
        try:
            if f"Decision graph node: #{decision['id']} " in p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"):
                return p
        except OSError:
            continue
    return None


def _rel(path: Path, project: Path) -> str:
    try:
        return Path(path).resolve().relative_to(Path(project).resolve()).as_posix()
    except ValueError:
        return str(path)


def note_history(graph, decision_id: int, event: str) -> None:
    """Append one line to the decision's status history (kept on the node)."""
    d = graph.get_node(decision_id)
    history = list(d["data"].get("history") or [])
    history.append({"at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
                    "status": d["data"].get("status"), "event": event})
    graph.update_data(decision_id, history=history[-30:])


def why_text(d: dict) -> str:
    data = d["data"]
    if data.get("status") == "stale":
        return data.get("stale_reason") or "marked stale"
    if data.get("status") == "needs_review":
        return data.get("review_reason") or "needs review"
    if data.get("verdict_summary"):
        return data["verdict_summary"]
    how = f" ({data.get('evidence')})" if data.get("evidence") else ""
    return (f"Chosen by a coding agent's {data.get('tool_name') or 'tool'} call{how}; "
            "no recorded reason beyond that yet.")


def write_record(project: Path, graph, decision_id: int, event: str | None = None) -> Path:
    """Create or update the decision's record; returns its path (also stored on the node)."""
    project = Path(project)
    if event:
        note_history(graph, decision_id, event)
    d = graph.get_node(decision_id)
    path = existing_path(project, d)
    block = "\n".join(summary_block(project, graph, d)) + "\n"
    if path is None:
        path = next_path(project, d)
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        title = ("AI model" if d["data"].get("kind") == "model"
                 else (d["data"].get("category") or "Decision").capitalize())
        text = f"# {path.stem[:4]}. {title}: {d['label']}\n\n" + block
    else:
        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        if BEGIN in text and END in text:
            head, rest = text.split(BEGIN, 1)
            text = head + block.rstrip("\n") + rest.split(END, 1)[1]
            text = text.rstrip("\n") + "\n"
        else:
            text = text.rstrip("\n") + "\n\n" + block
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    graph.update_data(decision_id, decision_record=_rel(path, project))
    return path


def write_records(project: Path, graph, decision_ids, event: str, tracer=None,
                  out=None, entire=None) -> list[Path]:
    """write_record for several decisions, then offer each record to Entire Brain."""
    from notbydefault import brain
    decision_ids = list(decision_ids)
    paths = []
    for did in decision_ids:
        path = write_record(project, graph, did, event)
        paths.append(path)
        if tracer is not None:
            tracer.event("decision_record", "state", f"#{did}: {event} -> {_rel(path, project)}",
                         decision_id=did, path=_rel(path, project))
        saved, msg = brain.save(project, path, graph.get_node(did), entire)
        if tracer is not None:
            tracer.event("brain_saved" if saved else "brain_skipped",
                         "state" if saved else "recovery", msg, decision_id=did)
        if out is not None and (saved or did == decision_ids[0]):
            out(msg)
    return paths

def summary_block(project: Path, graph, d: dict) -> list[str]:
    from notbydefault.affected import describe
    from notbydefault.graph import affected_entries
    data = d["data"]
    lines = [BEGIN, "", "## Summary (NotByDefault)", "",
             f"- Decision graph node: #{d['id']} ({data.get('kind')}/{data.get('category')}: "
             f"`{d['label']}`)",
             f"- Status: {STATUS_TEXT.get(data.get('status'), data.get('status'))}"]
    if data.get("recommended"):
        lines.append(f"- Recommended: `{data['recommended']}`")
    if d.get("session_id"):
        lines.append(f"- Detected in agent session: `{d['session_id']}`")
    lines += ["", "### Why", "", why_text(d), ""]

    evidence = graph.neighbors(d["id"], ("supported_by",))
    lines += ["### Evidence", ""]
    for e in evidence:
        link = e["data"].get("path") or e["data"].get("url")
        lines.append(f"- #{e['id']} {e['label']}" + (f": `{link}`" if link else ""))
    key = {"stale": "stale_source", "needs_review": "review_source"}.get(data.get("status"))
    if key and data.get(key):
        lines.append(f"- Documentation: {data[key]}")
    if data.get("results"):
        lines.append(f"- Raw fit-test results: `{data['results']}`")
    if len(lines) and lines[-1] == "":
        lines.append("- none recorded")
    lines.append("")

    rejected = graph.neighbors(d["id"], ("rejects",))
    lines += ["### Rejected alternatives", ""]
    lines += [f"- `{a['label']}`: {a['data'].get('reason') or 'no reason recorded'}"
              for a in rejected] or ["- none recorded"]

def requirement_impacts(snap: Snapshot, rid: int) -> list[tuple[int, str]]:
    """(decision id, status) a requirement made stale or needs-review."""
    req = snap.nodes.get(rid) or {"data": {}}
    found: dict[int, str] = {}
    for k, v in ((req["data"].get("judged") or {}).items()):
        if v.get("status") in ("stale", "needs_review") and int(k) in snap.nodes:
            found[int(k)] = v["status"]
    for d in snap.of_type("decision"):
        data = d["data"]
        if data.get("stale_cause") == rid:
            found[d["id"]] = "stale"
        elif data.get("review_cause") == rid and d["id"] not in found:
            found[d["id"]] = "needs_review"
    return sorted(found.items())

# --- activity: what happened, with cause -> effect -------------------------------------

HOOK_LINE = re.compile(r"^(\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d \d\d:\d\d:\d\d) ask tool=(\S+) \d+ms (.*)$")


@dataclass
class Event:
    at: datetime
    kind: str            # caught | hook | pivot | requirement | fit_check | resolve | ui | setup
    title: str
    detail: str = ""
    href: str | None = None
    effects: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)   # {"label", "href", "status"}
    trace_id: str | None = None
    via_ui: bool = False

    @property
    def key(self) -> str:
        return hashlib.sha1(f"{self.kind}|{self.at.isoformat()}|{self.title}".encode()).hexdigest()[:10]


def _effect(snap: Snapshot, did: int, status: str | None = None) -> dict:
    d = snap.nodes.get(did)
    label = f"#{did} {d['label']}" if d else f"#{did}"
    return {"label": label, "href": f"/decisions/{did}", "status": status or (status_of(d) if d else "")}


def _tail(path: Path, limit: int = 200_000) -> list[str]:
    try:
        with path.open("rb") as f:
            f.seek(0, os.SEEK_END)
            f.seek(max(0, f.tell() - limit))
            return f.read().decode("utf-8", "replace").splitlines()
    except OSError:
        return []


def ui_log(project: Path) -> list[dict]:
    out = []
    for line in _tail(Path(project) / ".notbydefault" / ACTIVITY_LOG):
        try:
            out.append(json.loads(line))
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            continue
    return out


def events(project: Path, snap: Snapshot) -> list[Event]:
    """Newest first."""
    from notbydefault.costs import load_checks
    project = Path(project)
    ev: list[Event] = []
    ui = ui_log(project)
    ui_reqs = {e.get("node") for e in ui if e.get("action") == "require"}
    init = [n for n in snap.nodes.values() if n["data"].get("source") == "init"]
    if init:
        goal = next((n["label"] for n in init if n["type"] == "goal"), "")
        ev.append(Event(parse_time(init[0]["created_at"]), "setup", "Project initialised",
                        "; ".join(n["label"] for n in init if n["type"] != "goal")
                        + (f" — goal: {goal}" if goal else ""), "/graph"))
    for d in snap.of_type("decision"):
        data = d["data"]
        how = f"{data.get('kind')}/{data.get('category')}"
        via = f" via {data['tool_name']} call" if data.get("tool_name") else ""
        ev.append(Event(parse_time(d["created_at"]), "caught", f"Caught #{d['id']} {d['label']}",
                        f"{how}{via}" + (f" ({data['evidence']})" if data.get("evidence") else ""),
                        f"/decisions/{d['id']}", [_effect(snap, d["id"])]))
    for line in _tail(project / ".notbydefault" / "hook.log"):
        m = HOOK_LINE.match(line)
        if not m:
            continue
        msg = m.group(3).split(" Run `", 1)[0].removeprefix("NotByDefault: ")
        did = re.search(r" check (\d+) ", m.group(3))
        ev.append(Event(parse_time(m.group(1)), "hook", f"Hook interrupted a {m.group(2)} call",
                        msg, f"/decisions/{did.group(1)}" if did else None,
                        [_effect(snap, int(did.group(1)))] if did else []))
    for r in snap.of_type("requirement") + snap.of_type("constraint"):
        if r["data"].get("source") in ("init", "check"):
            continue
        effects = [_effect(snap, did, st) for did, st in requirement_impacts(snap, r["id"])]
        ev.append(Event(parse_time(r["data"].get("added_at") or r["created_at"]), "requirement",
                        f"Requirement #{r['id']}: {r['label']}",
                        f"{len(effects)} decision(s) affected" if effects else
                        "no decision affected", f"/graph?req={r['id']}", effects,
                        via_ui=r["id"] in ui_reqs))
    for p in snap.of_type("pivot"):
        data = p["data"]
        ids = data.get("decisions") or []
        ev.append(Event(parse_time(data.get("proposed_at") or p["created_at"]), "pivot",
                        f"Pivot proposed: {p['label']}",
                        "; ".join(c.get("why", "") for c in data.get("conflicts") or [])[:300],
                        f"/nodes/{p['id']}", [_effect(snap, i) for i in ids]))
        if data.get("resolved_at"):
            st = data.get("status")
            ev.append(Event(parse_time(data["resolved_at"]), "pivot", f"Pivot {st}: {p['label']}",
                            "decisions it affects are now stale" if st == "accepted" else "",
                            f"/nodes/{p['id']}",
                            [_effect(snap, i, "stale" if st == "accepted" else None) for i in ids]))
    for c in load_checks(project):
        v = c.data.get("verdict") or {}
        rec = (v.get("recommended") or [None])[0]
        ev.append(Event(parse_time(c.run_at), "fit_check",
                        f"Fit check #{c.decision_id}: {v.get('kind') or 'no verdict'}"
                        + (f" → {rec}" if v.get("kind") == "switch" and rec else ""),
                        (v.get("summary") or "")[:280], f"/decisions/{c.decision_id}",
                        [_effect(snap, c.decision_id)], c.data.get("trace_id")))
    for d in snap.of_type("decision"):
        res = d["data"].get("resolution")
        if res:
            ev.append(Event(parse_time(res.get("at")), "resolve",
                            f"Resolved #{d['id']}: {res.get('from')} → {res.get('to')}",
                            f"branch {res.get('branch')}; tests {res.get('tests')}; "
                            f"verifiers {res.get('verifiers')}", f"/decisions/{d['id']}",
                            [_effect(snap, d["id"])], res.get("trace_id")))
    for e in ui:
        if e.get("action") == "require":
            continue
        ev.append(Event(parse_time(e.get("at")) or datetime.now(timezone.utc), "ui",
                        e.get("title", "UI action"), e.get("detail", ""), e.get("href"),
                        [_effect(snap, i) for i in e.get("decisions") or [] if i in snap.nodes],
                        via_ui=True))
    ev = [e for e in ev if e.at is not None]
    return sorted(ev, key=lambda e: e.at, reverse=True)

content.text:
Step 1 is done: `notbydefault/ui/data.py` is the read-only data layer, and it works on a throwaway copy of demo-app.

What it covers:
- **Graph reads:** `graph.db` is opened read-only for one short read and then closed, so it won't block the hook in the other window.
- **Change detection:** a cheap version signature built from file timestamps and sizes, for live polling.
- **Fit-check table:** rebuilt with the CLI's own `fit.report.table_rows`, so the headers and cells match the report exactly.
- **Decision receipt data:** reason, call site, affected code, evidence, rejected alternatives, caveats and assumptions from the record, failure bank, record commit / checkpoint link, and resolve PR.
- **Activity and timeline events:** caught decisions, hook interrupts, requirements with what they made stale or needs-review, pivots, fit checks, resolves, and UI actions.
- **Graph, evals and costs:** graph elements (with a `since` filter for new nodes), evals laid out like `eval --compare` (v1–v3 plus held-out), and costs computed with the same functions `export-costs` uses.
- **Safe file access:** only files inside the project, nothing secret-looking, and only a short list of text file types.

I also added `records.review()` in `records.py` for the "mark reviewed / add reason" action. A reason given by a person now shows up as the decision's "why".

Two things in that check: the commit/checkpoint link came back empty, which is expected because the throwaway copy isn't a git repo (the real demo-app is). The demo graph currently has no pivots and no needs-review or stale decisions, so those empty states will show until the require demo runs.

The playwright Python package isn't installed for any Python here, so I'm using the Chrome install at `C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome` as the browser. The project's `.venv` (the interpreter the hooks use) didn't have the UI packages, so I installed fastapi, uvicorn, jinja2, python-multipart and playwright into it with pip. I did not run `playwright install`. The plain `python` on PATH is 3.11, but the project needs 3.12; the existing suite passes (400 tests) under 3.12.

Next is step 2: the app, base template, static assets and the Overview page.

Map each to a check we already have: cost → list price × volume vs budget; quality → fit-check results; latency → measured; region → service_facts.yaml; popularity → always "not evidence for your project". Add `notbydefault watch`: re-evaluate them (requirements, prices from providers.yaml, new models from the providers' model lists, real call volume from neatlogs traces when available) and re-open any decision whose assumption changed, putting its failure-bank cases first. """The FastAPI app behind `notbydefault ui`: server-rendered pages (Jinja2, autoescaped), HTMX
fragments for live updates, and a few actions that call the existing Python functions.

Safety: binds 127.0.0.1 only; requests must name 127.0.0.1/localhost as Host (no DNS
rebinding); every write needs the per-run CSRF token AND a same-origin Origin/Referer, and is
refused outright with --read-only; only files inside the project are shown, never secrets.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import secrets
import threading
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Request
from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, JSONResponse, Response
from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles
from jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape

from notbydefault.ui import data, mdlite

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
STATUS_TEXT = {"unreviewed": "unreviewed", "reviewed": "reviewed", "needs_review": "needs review",
               "stale": "stale", "accepted": "accepted", "proposed": "proposed", "kept": "kept",
               "adjusting": "adjusting"}
KIND_TEXT = {"caught": "caught", "hook": "hook", "pivot": "pivot", "requirement": "requirement",
             "fit_check": "fit check", "resolve": "resolve", "ui": "you", "setup": "setup"}


def _ago(t: datetime | None) -> str:
    if t is None:
        return "-"
    s = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - t).total_seconds()
    if s < 60:
        return "just now"
    for unit, n in (("d", 86400), ("h", 3600), ("m", 60)):
        if s >= n:
            return f"{int(s // n)}{unit} ago"
    return "-"


def _when(value) -> str:
    t = value if isinstance(value, datetime) else data.parse_time(value)
    return t.astimezone().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") if t else "-"


def _money(v, places: int = 2) -> str:
    if v in ("", None):
        return "-"
    return f"${float(v):,.{places}f}"


def make_env() -> Environment:
    env = Environment(loader=FileSystemLoader(str(HERE / "templates")),
                      autoescape=select_autoescape(default=True, default_for_string=True))
    env.filters.update(ago=_ago, when=_when, money=_money, md=mdlite.render,
                       status_text=lambda s: STATUS_TEXT.get(s, s or "-"),
                       kind_text=lambda k: KIND_TEXT.get(k, k),
                       pct=lambda v: "-" if v is None else f"{v:.0%}")
    return env


class Settings:
    def __init__(self, project: Path, read_only: bool, client_factory, entire,
                 allowed_hosts: tuple[str, ...]):
        self.project = Path(project).resolve()
        self.read_only = read_only
        self.client_factory = client_factory   # tests: fake providers (no network)
        self.entire = entire
        self.allowed_hosts = allowed_hosts
        self.csrf = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
        self.lock = threading.Lock()           # one action at a time


def create_app(project: Path, read_only: bool = False, client_factory=None, entire=None,
               allowed_hosts: tuple[str, ...] = ("127.0.0.1", "localhost")) -> FastAPI:
    cfg = Settings(project, read_only, client_factory, entire, allowed_hosts)
    env = make_env()
    app = FastAPI(docs_url=None, redoc_url=None, openapi_url=None)
    app.state.cfg = cfg
    app.mount("/static", StaticFiles(directory=str(HERE / "static")), name="static")

    @app.middleware("http")
    async def guard(request: Request, call_next):
        host = (request.headers.get("host") or "").rsplit(":", 1)[0].strip("[]")
        if host not in cfg.allowed_hosts:
            return Response("Bad host", status_code=400)
        response = await call_next(request)
        response.headers.update({
            "Content-Security-Policy": "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; "
            "style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; "
            "object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'",
            "X-Content-Type-Options": "nosniff", "Referrer-Policy": "same-origin",
            "X-Frame-Options": "DENY", "Cache-Control": "no-store"})
        return response

    def page(request: Request, name: str, status_code: int = 200, **ctx) -> HTMLResponse:
        ctx.update(request=request, read_only=cfg.read_only, csrf=cfg.csrf,
                   project_name=cfg.project.name, project=str(cfg.project),
                   path=request.url.path, version=data.version(cfg.project))
        return HTMLResponse(env.get_template(name).render(**ctx), status_code=status_code)

    app.state.page = page
    app.state.env = env

    from notbydefault.ui import routes
    routes.register(app, cfg, page)
    return app


def same_origin(request: Request) -> bool:
    host = request.headers.get("host", "")
    for header in ("origin", "referer"):
        value = request.headers.get(header)
        if value:
            return urlsplit(value).netloc == host
    return False


def check_write(request: Request, cfg: Settings, form_token: str | None) -> None:
    """403 unless writes are enabled, the request is same-origin and carries the token."""
    if cfg.read_only:
        raise HTTPException(403, "read-only mode: actions are disabled")
    token = request.headers.get("x-csrf-token") or form_token or ""
    if not same_origin(request) or not secrets.compare_digest(token, cfg.csrf):
        raise HTTPException(403, "cross-site request refused (missing or wrong CSRF token)")


def log_action(project: Path, action: str, title: str, detail: str = "", href: str | None = None,
               decisions: list[int] | None = None, node: int | None = None) -> None:
    entry = {"at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds"), "action": action,
             "title": title, "detail": detail, "href": href, "decisions": decisions or [],
             "node": node}
    path = Path(project) / ".notbydefault" / data.ACTIVITY_LOG
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(json.dumps(entry) + "\n")


def serve(project: Path, port: int = 8765, read_only: bool = False, open_browser: bool = True) -> int:
    import uvicorn
    import webbrowser
    project = Path(project).resolve()
    if not project.is_dir():
        print(f"Not a directory: {project}")
        return 1
    if not data.db_path(project).exists():
        print(f"No Decision Graph at {data.db_path(project)} yet; the UI will show it once "
              "`init` or the hook creates it.")
    url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/"
    print(f"NotByDefault UI for {project}{' (read-only)' if read_only else ''}: {url}  "
          "(Ctrl+C to stop)")
    if open_browser:
        threading.Timer(1.0, webbrowser.open, (url,)).start()
    uvicorn.run(create_app(project, read_only), host="127.0.0.1", port=port, log_level="warning")
    return 0

"""UI actions. Each one calls the existing Python function (records.review, stale.require,
resolve.Resolver in dry-run mode), is refused with --read-only, needs the CSRF token and a
same-origin request, runs one at a time, and is logged to the activity feed."""
from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi import FastAPI, Request

from notbydefault.graph import Graph
from notbydefault.ui import data
from notbydefault.ui.app import check_write, log_action

MAX_TEXT = 2000


async def _form(request: Request) -> dict:
    try:
        form = await request.form()
    except Exception:          # noqa: BLE001  (no or malformed body)
        return {}
    return {k: str(v) for k, v in form.items()}


def register(app: FastAPI, cfg, page) -> None:
    project = cfg.project

    def result(request: Request, title: str, ok: bool = True, **ctx):
        name = "_action_result.html"
        if request.headers.get("hx-request"):
            return page(request, name, title=title, ok=ok, **ctx)
        return page(request, "action_page.html", title=title, ok=ok, inner=name, **ctx)

    @app.post("/decisions/{did}/review")
    async def review(request: Request, did: int):
        form = await _form(request)
        check_write(request, cfg, form.get("csrf_token"))
        reason = (form.get("reason") or "").strip()[:MAX_TEXT]
        mark = form.get("mark", "reviewed") != "reason"
        if not mark and not reason:
            return result(request, "Write a reason first.", ok=False, status_code=400)
        from notbydefault.records import review as review_fn
        with cfg.lock, Graph.for_project(project) as g:
            d = g.get_node(did)
            if d is None or d["type"] != "decision":
                return result(request, f"No decision #{did}.", ok=False, status_code=404)
            before = data.status_of(d)
            path = review_fn(project, g, did, reason, mark_reviewed=mark)
        rel = data.rel_to(project, str(path))
        title = (f"#{did} marked reviewed" if mark else f"Reason added to #{did}")
        log_action(project, "review" if mark else "reason", f"{title}: {d['label']}",
                   reason or f"{before} → reviewed", f"/decisions/{did}", [did])
        return result(request, title, lines=[f"status: {before} → {'reviewed' if mark else before}"]
                      + ([f"reason: {reason}"] if reason else []), record=rel,
                      reload=f"/decisions/{did}")

    @app.post("/requirements")
    async def add_requirement(request: Request):
        form = await _form(request)
        check_write(request, cfg, form.get("csrf_token"))
        text = " ".join((form.get("text") or "").split())[:MAX_TEXT]
        if not text:
            return result(request, "Write the requirement first.", ok=False, status_code=400)
        from notbydefault.stale import require
        if not cfg.lock.acquire(blocking=False):
            return result(request, "Another action is still running; try again in a moment.",
                          ok=False, status_code=409)
        try:
            before = {d["id"]: data.status_of(d) for d in data.snapshot(project).of_type("decision")}
            lines: list[str] = []
            client = cfg.client_factory() if cfg.client_factory else None
            code = require(project, text, client=client, out=lines.append)
        finally:
            cfg.lock.release()
        snap = data.snapshot(project)
        reqs = [r for r in snap.of_type("requirement") if r["label"] == text]
        rid = reqs[-1]["id"] if reqs else None
        changed = [(snap.nodes[i], before.get(i, "unreviewed"), data.status_of(snap.nodes[i]))
                   for i in sorted(before) if i in snap.nodes
                   and data.status_of(snap.nodes[i]) != before[i]]
        log_action(project, "require", f"Requirement added: {text}",
                   f"{len(changed)} decision(s) changed", f"/graph?req={rid}" if rid else None,
                   [d["id"] for d, _, _ in changed], node=rid)
        return result(request, f"Requirement #{rid}: {text}" if rid else "Requirement not added",
                      ok=code == 0, changed=changed, report="\n".join(lines), rid=rid)

    @app.post("/decisions/{did}/resolve-dry-run")
    async def resolve_dry_run(request: Request, did: int):
        form = await _form(request)
        check_write(request, cfg, form.get("csrf_token"))
        from notbydefault.resolve import Resolver, ResolveOptions
        if not cfg.lock.acquire(blocking=False):
            return result(request, "Another action is still running; try again in a moment.",
                          ok=False, status_code=409)
        lines: list[str] = []
        try:
            client = cfg.client_factory() if cfg.client_factory else None
            r = Resolver(project, did, ResolveOptions(apply=False), ask=lambda _q: "n",
                         out=lines.append, client=client, entire=cfg.entire)
            code = r.run()
        finally:
            cfg.lock.release()
        diffs = [e.diff() for e in getattr(r, "edits", [])]
        log_action(project, "resolve_dry_run", f"Resolve dry run for #{did}",
                   f"{len(diffs)} file(s) would change; nothing was written", f"/decisions/{did}",
                   [did])
        return result(request, f"Resolve #{did}: dry run (nothing changed)", ok=code in (0, 2),
                      report="\n".join(lines), diff="".join(diffs),
                      trace_id=getattr(r.tracer, "trace_id", None) if r.tracer else None)

"""Screenshots of every UI page, light and dark, into docs/screenshots/.

Runs against a throwaway copy of demo-app (graph.db copied with SQLite's backup API, so a
check writing to the live graph is never disturbed) and uses the installed Chrome via
Playwright (no `playwright install`). Read-only: no actions are clicked.

    python scripts/ui_screenshots.py [--width 1280] [--out docs/screenshots]
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import shutil
import socket
import sqlite3
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO))

PAGES = [("overview", "/"), ("decisions", "/decisions"), ("decision", "/decisions/{did}"),
         ("graph", "/graph"), ("timeline", "/timeline"), ("evals", "/evals"),
         ("costs", "/costs")]


def throwaway_demo(dest: Path) -> Path:
    src = REPO / "demo-app"
    shutil.copytree(src, dest, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns(
        "graph.db*", "cache", "__pycache__", ".demo-run"))
    live = sqlite3.connect(f"{(src / '.notbydefault' / 'graph.db').resolve().as_uri()}?mode=ro",
                           uri=True)
    copy = sqlite3.connect(dest / ".notbydefault" / "graph.db")
    live.backup(copy)
    live.close()
    copy.close()
    return dest


def free_port() -> int:
    with socket.socket() as s:
        s.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        return s.getsockname()[1]


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--width", type=int, default=1280)
    ap.add_argument("--height", type=int, default=860)
    ap.add_argument("--out", default=str(REPO / "docs" / "screenshots"))
    ap.add_argument("--decision", type=int, default=21)
    args = ap.parse_args()
    import uvicorn
    from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
    from notbydefault.ui.app import create_app

    out = Path(args.out)
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        project = throwaway_demo(Path(tmp) / "demo-app")
        port = free_port()
        server = uvicorn.Server(uvicorn.Config(create_app(project), host="127.0.0.1", port=port,
                                               log_level="warning"))
        threading.Thread(target=server.run, daemon=True).start()
        while not server.started:
            time.sleep(0.05)
        base = f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}"
        with sync_playwright() as pw:
            browser = pw.chromium.launch(channel="chrome")
            for scheme in ("light", "dark"):
                ctx = browser.new_context(viewport={"width": args.width, "height": args.height},
                                          color_scheme=scheme, device_scale_factor=1)
                page = ctx.new_page()
                errors: list[str] = []
                page.on("pageerror", lambda e: errors.append(str(e)))
                page.on("console", lambda m: errors.append(m.text) if m.type == "error" else None)
                for name, path in PAGES:
                    page.goto(base + path.format(did=args.decision), wait_until="networkidle")
                    if name == "graph":
                        page.wait_for_timeout(1200)       # dagre layout
                    over = page.evaluate("document.documentElement.scrollWidth - innerWidth")
                    file = out / f"{name}-{scheme}.png"
                    page.screenshot(path=str(file), full_page=name != "graph")
                    print(f"{file.relative_to(REPO)}  horizontal overflow: {over}px")
                if errors:
                    print(f"{scheme}: browser errors:\n  " + "\n  ".join(errors))
                ctx.close()
            browser.close()
        server.should_exit = True
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

ui: a local web UI for the Decision Graph (receipts, live graph, actions)

`python -m notbydefault ui --project <dir> [--port 8765] [--read-only] [--no-browser]`
FastAPI + Jinja2 (autoescaped) + HTMX + Cytoscape/dagre, all JS vendored in
notbydefault/ui/static/vendor (htmx 1.9.12, cytoscape 3.30.2, dagre 0.8.5,
cytoscape-dagre 2.5.0; licenses in LICENSES.txt). Binds 127.0.0.1 only.

Pages
- Overview: decisions caught / unreviewed / needs review / stale / fit checks /
  savings found, latest activity (hook interrupts, catches, requirements, pivots,
  fit checks, resolves, UI actions), monthly savings per decision at each check's
  own volume (never summed), "no decision without a why".
- Decisions: filter by status and type; choice, status pill, last evidence and a
  "chosen by default" flag (picked by a tool call, no reason recorded).
- Decision receipt: choice, who/when (tool call), why, cause of stale/needs review,
  record + Entire checkpoint link (commit that added the record), results file,
  neatlogs trace (copy + link); affected code from Entire Graph; the fit-check table
  built with fit.report.table_rows, so it matches the CLI report cell for cell;
  recommendations, bar, rejected alternatives, caveats and assumptions (from the
  record), failure bank, resolve PR + diff, status history.
- Graph: shape and colour per node type, status colour on decisions, type filters,
  focus on one decision, requirement impact highlight, side panel; picks LR or TB
  layout, whichever fits the canvas at the larger zoom.
- Timeline: oldest first, cause -> effect chips (requirement -> #21 needs review).
- Evals: v1..v3 side by side as `eval --compare`, held-out columns separate,
  inline SVG bars, trace ids with copy/link.
- Costs: costs.md/csv computed now with the export-costs functions; ASSUMPTION
  labels highlighted.

Live: graph.db is opened read-only (sqlite mode=ro) for one short read per
request. The overview polls every 2s and gets 204 when nothing changed; the graph
polls a file-stat version and animates new nodes in with a toast.

Actions (hidden and refused with --read-only; CSRF token + same-origin required;
one at a time; logged to .notbydefault/ui-activity.jsonl and the feed):
- mark reviewed / add a reason: new records.review() -> graph + decision record;
  why_text now shows a person's reason.
- add a requirement: stale.require(), then shows each decision's old -> new status.
- resolve dry run: resolve.Resolver(apply=False) -> plan and diff; apply stays CLI.

Safety: Host header must be 127.0.0.1/localhost, strict CSP (no inline script),
files served only from inside the project, never .env/secret-looking files, .git,
caches or binaries.

Tests: tests/test_ui.py (18) on a fit-checked throwaway repo with fake providers:
every page, CLI table parity, live poll returns new nodes and feed items, reads
hold no lock, escaping of a malicious reason/label, read-only refuses writes, CSRF
and cross-origin rejection, bad Host, path traversal and secrets, each action.
The conftest demo-app guard now covers the UI's read-only reader too.
scripts/ui_screenshots.py takes light/dark screenshots of every page from a
throwaway copy of demo-app (graph.db copied with the SQLite backup API) with the
installed Chrome; output in docs/screenshots/.

pyproject: `ui` extra (fastapi, uvicorn, jinja2, python-multipart); dev adds
httpx and playwright; UI templates/static shipped as package data.

def handle(event: dict, project_dir: Path, tracer=None) -> dict | None:
    from notbydefault.detect import detect
    from notbydefault.fit.tracing import Tracer

    started = time.perf_counter()
    tracer = tracer or Tracer()
    with tracer.step("detect", "tool_use", reason="is this tool call a stack decision?"):
        detections = detect(event)
    if not detections:
        return None
    found = list(detections)

    import os
    from notbydefault.briefing import HOOK_LINES, build
    from notbydefault.graph import Graph

    with Graph.for_project(project_dir) as graph:
        with tracer.step("already_decided", "context",
                         reason="don't interrupt for a choice the project already made"):
            detections = [d for d in detections
                          if not skip_if_decided(graph, d, event, project_dir, tracer)]
        if not detections:   # a detection, but nothing to ask: still worth a trace
            _send_hook_trace(event, project_dir, tracer, started, interrupted=False, info={
                "tool_name": event.get("tool_name"),
                "skipped": [{"kind": d.kind, "chosen": d.chosen} for d in found]})
            return None
        with tracer.step("record", "state", reason="store the decision in the Decision Graph"):
            ids = [record(graph, d, event, project_dir) for d in detections]
        with tracer.step("briefing", "context",
                         reason="related past decisions, rejected alternatives, history and "
                                "reusable code, from the graph and the precomputed Entire cache"):
            lines: list[str] = []
            for i in ids:
                lines += [l for l in build(project_dir, graph, graph.get_node(i)) if l not in lines]
            lines = lines[:HOOK_LINES]
            tracer.event("briefing_built", "context", f"{len(lines)} briefing line(s)",
                         lines=len(lines))

    parts = [f"this picks {d.chosen} as your {d.kind}"
             + (f" ({d.category})" if d.kind == "service" else "")
             + f". Run `{check_command(i, project_dir)}` to test the fit."
             for d, i in zip(detections, ids)]
    reason = "NotByDefault: " + " Also: ".join(parts)
    if lines:
        reason += ("\nBriefing (full version in `check`):\n"
                   + "\n".join(f"- {l}" for l in lines))

    if os.environ.get("NOTBYDEFAULT_ENTIRE") != "0":
        with tracer.step("refresh_cache", "planning",
                         reason="the Entire lookups are slow: run them detached so the next "
                                "briefing and `check` have them"):
            try:
                _spawn_refresh(project_dir, ids)
            except Exception as e:
                tracer.event("refresh_spawn_failed", "recovery", f"{e!r}; briefing uses the old cache")
                _log(project_dir, f"briefing refresh spawn failed: {e!r}")

    _send_hook_trace(event, project_dir, tracer, started, interrupted=True, info={
        "tool_name": event.get("tool_name"),
        "decisions": [{"decision_id": i, "kind": d.kind, "chosen": d.chosen,
                       "category": d.category, "file": d.file}
                      for d, i in zip(detections, ids)],
        "briefing_lines": len(lines)})

    return {
        "hookSpecificOutput": {
            "hookEventName": "PreToolUse",
            "permissionDecision": "ask",
            "permissionDecisionReason": reason,
        }
    }


def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    start = time.perf_counter()
    project_dir = _project_dir(argv, {}) if "--project" in argv else None
    try:
        event = json.loads(sys.stdin.buffer.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace") or "{}")
        project_dir = _project_dir(argv, event)
        out = handle(event, project_dir)
        if out:
            sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(out))
            sys.stdout.flush()
            ms = (time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000
            _log(project_dir, f"ask tool={event.get('tool_name')} {ms:.0f}ms "
                              f"{out['hookSpecificOutput']['permissionDecisionReason']}")
    except Exception:

    """{"status": "stale"|"needs_review"|"valid"|"unclear", "reason", "basis", "source"}.

    guess never invalidates a decision.

        _m, _r, source = provider_facts(decision, pricing, catalog)

                "source": source}
    if cost and cost["over_budget"]:

        return {"status": "stale", "reason": cost_line(cost), "basis": "list price x recorded volume",
                "source": f"{cost['price']['source']} ({cost['price']['fetched']})"}
    svc = service_residency(decision, constraints, catalog, facts)
    if svc:
        basis = ("service documentation" if svc["status"] == "stale"
                 else "depends on deployment")

    if verdict.get("affected") is None:
        return {"status": "unclear", "reason": verdict.get("reason", ""), "basis": "", "source": ""}
    if verdict["affected"]:
        prop = verdict.get("property") or ""

        return {"status": "needs_review", "basis": "model judgement (nothing documented)",
                "source": "", "property": prop, "reason": f"{prop}: {reason}" if prop else reason}
    return {"status": "valid", "reason": verdict.get("reason", ""), "basis": "", "source": ""}

"""Test scout: edge cases the agent discussed while touching a decision's code but never tested.

  1. affected code of the decision (Entire Graph analysis stored on the node)
  2. checkpoints whose sessions touched those files (`entire checkpoint list` + `explain --json`)
  3. their transcripts (`entire checkpoint explain <id> --transcript`): user/assistant text that
     mentions the files, functions or edge-case words
  4. a Groq model extracts edge cases from those excerpts, quoting its evidence; a case whose
     quote isn't in the transcripts, or that the existing test inputs already cover, is dropped
  5. the rest are saved as "suggested" verifier cases in .notbydefault/suggested/<id>.jsonl;
     nothing runs them until someone promotes them into the samples file
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

EDGE_WORDS = re.compile(r"\b(edge case|empty|blank|unicode|emoji|timezone|time zone|leap|null|"
                        r"none|missing|malformed|invalid|too long|large|huge|duplicate|"
                        r"what if|what about|fails?|crash|error|retry|timeout|rate limit|"
                        r"multilingual|language|cancel+ed|ambiguous|relative date|not tested|"
                        r"untested|corner case)\b", re.IGNORECASE)
MAX_EXCERPT_CHARS = 9000
MAX_CHECKPOINTS = 5

                "may not be tested. Answer with one JSON object only.")

Code: {code}

Existing test inputs (truncated):
{tests}

Conversation excerpts (from Entire checkpoints):
{excerpts}

List edge cases for this feature that the conversation raises. For each, quote the exact words
from the excerpts that raise it (copy them verbatim, 3 to 20 words), and say whether the existing
test inputs already cover it. Return
{{"cases": [{{"input": "<a concrete test input for the feature>", "why": "<one line>",
             "evidence": "<verbatim quote>", "already_tested": true or false}}]}}"""


def _text(message) -> str:
    content = (message or {}).get("content") if isinstance(message, dict) else message
    if isinstance(content, str):
        return content
    if isinstance(content, list):
        return "\n".join(c.get("text", "") for c in content
                         if isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("type") == "text")
    return ""


def excerpts(transcript: list[dict], needles: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """User/assistant text that mentions the code or an edge-case word."""
    out = []
    for row in transcript:
        if row.get("type") not in ("user", "assistant"):
            continue
        text = _text(row.get("message")).strip()
        if not text or text.startswith("<"):
            continue
        if any(n and n.lower() in text.lower() for n in needles) and EDGE_WORDS.search(text):
            out.append(f"[{row['type']}] " + " ".join(text.split())[:1200])
    return out

        ("Fit test results " + rctx.pricing_fetched_at[:10] + f" ({rctx.n_samples} inputs)",
         {"kind": "fit_test", "path": _rel(results_path, project_root), "spent": rctx.spent,

         {"kind": "verifiers", "path": _rel(vpath, project_root), "checks": rctx.verifier_checks,
          "trust": rctx.trust}),

    for label, data in evidence:
